FROM python:3.12-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt /app/requirements.txt
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r /app/requirements.txt

COPY FrontEndApplicationLib /app/FrontEndApplicationLib
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir /app/FrontEndApplicationLib

COPY build_info.json    /app/build_info.json
COPY app.py             /app/app.py
COPY healthcheck        /app/healthcheck
COPY displayChrome      /app/displayChrome
COPY security           /app/security
COPY externalInterface  /app/externalInterface

ENV PORT=7860     CERTS_DIR=/certs     SSL_CERTFILE=/certs/evalcare.crt SSL_KEYFILE=/certs/evalcare.key
EXPOSE 7860
CMD ["python", "app.py"]

FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir fastapi uvicorn httpx
# Build context is the repo root; reach the canonical _start_website.py
# in architecture/DevOpsBuildDeployAndEnvironmentManagement/.
COPY architecture/DevOpsBuildDeployAndEnvironmentManagement/_start_website.py /app/_start_website.py
EXPOSE 80
EXPOSE 443
# Run: docker run -v <certs>:/certs:ro -v <website-staging>:/website:ro \
#                 -p 80:80 -p 443:443 ch-website
ENTRYPOINT ["python", "/app/_start_website.py", "/certs", "/website"]
